ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: P1 and P2 plants of a certain diploid plant are crossed to obtain F1, and F1 self-fertilizes to obtain F2. PCR detection is performed on individual DNA, and the electrophoresis results of the products are shown in the figure, where ①–⑧ are some F2 individuals. The upper 2 bands are amplification products of one pair of alleles, and the lower 2 bands are amplification products of another pair of alleles. These 2 pairs of alleles are located on non-homologous chromosomes. Answer the question: Are the PCR product electrophoresis results of the offspring from crossing ③ and ⑦ the same as or different from the electrophoresis results of ② and ⑧?

ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: P1 and P2 plants of a certain diploid plant are crossed to obtain F1, and F1 self-fertilizes to obtain F2. PCR detection is performed on individual DNA, and the electrophoresis results of the products are shown in the figure, where ①–⑧ are some F2 individuals. The upper 2 bands are amplification products of one pair of alleles, and the lower 2 bands are amplification products of another pair of alleles. These 2 pairs of alleles are located on non-homologous chromosomes. Answer the question: Are the PCR product electrophoresis results of the offspring from crossing ③ and ⑦ the same as or different from the electrophoresis results of ② and ⑧?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In the figure, the electrophoresis lanes include P1, P2, F1, and F2 individuals ①–⑧. The upper two bands represent amplification products of one pair of alleles, which can be denoted as A and a; the lower two bands represent amplification products of another pair of alleles, which can be denoted as B and b. Observing the F2 individuals: ③ has only the A band in the upper part and both B and b bands in the lower part, so it is AABb; ⑦ has only the a band in the upper part and only the b band in the lower part, so it is aabb. ② shows both A and a bands in the upper part and only the b band in the lower part, so it is Aabb; ⑧ shows both bands for both pairs of alleles in the upper and lower parts, so it is AaBb. Then reason: ③×⑦ is AABb×aabb. At the upper locus, AA×aa gives offspring all Aa, and electrophoresis shows the upper two bands; at the lower locus, Bb×bb gives offspring that may be Bb or bb, with electrophoresis respectively showing the lower two bands or only the b band. Therefore, the offspring PCR electrophoresis types are AaBb or Aabb, exactly the same as ⑧ and ② respectively.
